Install: Patch the OP Create dialog (Tab menu) now: adds the library tab. Safe to press repeatedly; does nothing if it is already installed. Check Status.
Uninstall: Remove the tab and restore every patched text and table of the OP Create dialog exactly as it was.
Autoinstall: Install automatically when the project starts and when this component is created or loaded. The dialog is rebuilt on every TouchDesigner launch, so keep this component in your project (or a startup template).
Refresh: Rescan <Library Root>/tox/*/*.tox and update the tab's list (and the out1 table).
Tablabel: Text shown on the new tab. It is also the tab's internal family name, so it is converted to a legal operator name (td-plugins becomes td_plugins). Changing it re-installs.
Createmode: embed: the new Base COMP contains a copy of the library tox (self-contained project). link: the COMP points at the library tox through its External Tox parameter and stays up to date with the library.
Status: Result of the last install/uninstall. Shows INCOMPATIBLE and the reason if the OP Create dialog of this TouchDesigner version differs from what the patches expect (nothing is patched then).
